### Course Description

This course addresses the fundamentals and practical application of **microcontrollers ($\mu\text{Cs}$)** to design and implement reliable **embedded systems**. 

Students learn the distinction between microprocessors and microcontrollers, memory-mapped peripheral architectures, deterministic real-time constraints, and low-level firmware engineering using **Embedded C**. The curriculum covers low-level bitwise operations, register manipulation, clock distribution, timers, pulse-width modulation (PWM), interrupt service routines via the NVIC, and standard serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C).

### 12-Week Course Curriculum

| Week | Module Title | Core Focus Areas | Status |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| **[Week 1](Week-1.qmd)** | **Introduction to Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers** | Real-Time constraints, MCU vs MPU, Von Neumann vs Harvard, ARM Cortex series | [Open Notes & Sim →](Week-1.qmd) |
| **[Week 2](Week-2.qmd)** | **Basics of Embedded C Programming** | Bitwise operators, Bitmasking, `volatile` keyword, Memory-mapped I/O | [Open Module →](Week-2.qmd) |
| **[Week 3](Week-3.qmd)** | **Intermediate STM32 Programming & Architecture** | ARM Cortex-M core, AHB/APB buses, RCC clock gating, GPIO configuration | [Open Module →](Week-3.qmd) |
| **[Week 4](Week-4.qmd)** | **Advanced Peripheral Interfacing** | Hardware Timers, Prescaler, Auto-Reload, PWM generation, NVIC Interrupts, ADC | [Open Module →](Week-4.qmd) |
| **[Week 5](Week-5.qmd)** | **Communication Protocols in Embedded Systems** | Parallel vs Serial, UART, SPI, I2C, Networking Concepts & Fieldbus Protocols | [Open Module →](Week-5.qmd) |
| **[Week 6](Week-6.qmd)** | **Compilation, Runtime, Memory & Power Management** | Compilation stages, Linking, Memory Layout (.text, .data, .bss), Boot sequence, Power modes | [Open Module →](Week-6.qmd) |
| **[Week 7](Week-7.qmd)** | **Programming Assignments & Hands-on Lab** | Priority Traffic Signal, Hardware Timers, 50 Hz PWM Servo Control | [Open Module →](Week-7.qmd) |
| **[Week 8](Week-8.qmd)** | **Software Architecture & Embedded Design Patterns** | Finite State Machines (FSM), Observer Pattern, Layered Architecture, Error Handling | [Open Module →](Week-8.qmd) |
| **[Week 9](Week-9.qmd)** | **Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)** | FreeRTOS Core, Tasks & TCB, Preemptive Scheduling, Queues, Semaphores, Mutexes | [Open Module →](Week-9.qmd) |
| **[Week 10](Week-10.qmd)** | **Efficient Embedded Systems & Optimization** | Interrupts vs Polling, DMA Transfers, Cache Memory Systems, Power & Code Optimization | [Open Module →](Week-10.qmd) |
| **[Week 11](Week-11.qmd)** | **Testing, Debugging & Performance Profiling** | In-Circuit Debugging, JTAG/SWD, DWT Cycle Profiling, Static Analysis, Unit Testing | [Open Module →](Week-11.qmd) |
| **[Week 12](Week-12.qmd)** | **Safety, Security & Professional Ethics** | Functional Safety, Fail-Safe Design, Embedded Cybersecurity, Engineering Ethics, MISRA-C | [Open Module →](Week-12.qmd) |
